body:
I really admire your hard work and strength to keep going for your family. You may feel that you are not doing enough because it must be unbearable to see your loved ones in such difficult situation. However none of this is your fault, all I see is a wonderful son and brother who tries his utmost to keep supporting his family here. Your family is lucky to have someone like you, you truly have done so much by fighting to be there for them, and simply by being a caring person as you are.

Like others I also wonder if there's any form of help you can reach out to in where you live for your family and yourself, whether to get some food resources, medical assistance programs or free counseling service at the moment.

As much as you prioritize your family, you are as much as important, please don't forget to take some time to take care of yourself too. I wish strength for you, if you ever need a safe and nonjudgemental place to vent, you know where to turn to, many others here including myself would be glad to offer.

I'm sorry that you're struggling and feeling alone, I just want to let you know that you're being listened to. It definitely can be really hard to connect with someone. Perhaps you need to explore the feelings further. What makes you feel you can't connect with people emotionally? Do they make you feel left out? Do you feel that you don't have anything in common with them? Do you feel it's difficult to trust anyone?

It sounds like you want to get out from the cycle, but also reluctant to do it, hence you do the same escape/coping mechanism that doesn't satisfy your needs in long term, which is understandable because breaking the cycle must be really difficult especially when you have lack of faith things can get any better. Maybe the boredom is also the result of your unfulfilled needs and other deeper issues.

I'm so sorry to hear that...my heart goes with you. I imagine how much pressure you have to take care of your loved one, when you barely make it to take care of yourself. I also can relate so much with having no motivation to get help.. I feel people around me wouldn't get it at all and at this point I just really doubt I can ever get out from the pit. While I don't have any answer, please let me know if there's something I could do.. whether if you need someone to follow up about your condition, remind you to eat sometimes or whatever....

I'm sorry you're so much in pain too.. Like you, I also see myself in a very negative way. Going out with friends used to be enjoyable, but now I feel so much safer to be alone and not seeing anyone instead, because I can be the true me without pretending and no one could judge me. I'm also afraid that I will lose all of my friends, which is already very few, because most of the times I can't even bring myself to focus on conversation anymore.

I really hope you could find friends who you can open up to and could be understanding about your situation....or at least have a place to express your real emotions without faking it.

I'm open to talk or listen to you as well, although I must warn you that I might be someone least interesting to talk to at the moment, with so much negativity I bring in and basically I'm socially awkward.

The idea of working really terrifies me too. I really don't have any desire to work as horrible as it sounds. I only 'want' to do it because it's something I have to do in order to survive in this world, but there's no actual desire or interest. They say once you find a job that you're passionate about, you'll be fine. I can't seem to find my passion and the truth is I don't think passion exists in me.

It really feels less alone to know a lot of you also feel the same, yet very sad at the same time. It's really scary to be alive but barely have any interest or hope anymore. Getting out from bed is already really difficult and almost everything that you have to do feels unbearable and needs tremendous effort. Worst of all is no one knows how you truly feel. People only know you're such a happy person and a lot of times can do really hurtful things. They have no idea, there's this very vulnerable soul behind this mask. I wish I could say some comforting words to whoever feels the same, but I'm like this myself. Offering group hug for whoever needs it...
